title: Microscope Video Recording Protocol
author: Daniel Vaulot
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k24cygw
materials: Need to buy the software (40 euros only) Advantage : Much smaller files and the software allow to finalize the films

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Microscope
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample from culture flasks by placing a drop between a slide and coverslip, then invert the slide so the objective is on the coverslip side.

substeps.instruction: Use x40 objective for most cultures

steps.title: Initialize Capture Software
steps.instruction: Install and launch the Infinity Capture software.

steps.title: Configure Video Resolution
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate resolution based on the camera model and desired video type.

substeps.instruction: For color videos (Infinity X): 800x608 (4:3) - note: only part of field is visible
For BW videos: 960x728 (4:3) with binning - note: full field is visible
For full resolution (Infinity X): 1920x1080 (16:9) - note: very large files, e.g., 30 sec = 700 Mo

steps.title: Acquire Video Footage
steps.instruction: Modify the AVI setups and launch acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Limit acquisition to usually 10-20 seconds at a time

steps.title: Configure Video de Luxe
steps.instruction: Transition from Image Capture to Video de Luxe for processing.

substeps.instruction: Set the resolution in Image Capture
Select 'Video Recording (Enregistrement video)' from the menu
Set resolution to 1280x720 (16:9) to select only the center of the camera field

steps.title: Edit Movie
steps.instruction: Create a new movie by assembling and refining the captured clips.

substeps.instruction: Cut the scenes (optimum duration is 20-30 sec max)

steps.title: Export Final Video
steps.instruction: Export the movie to wmv format (Windows Movie) for maximum compactness without loss of resolution.

substeps.instruction: Choose a format with the same aspect ratio as the original
Do not add sound unless adding music
